text:
Hello Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. My free slots are:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Thursday 10:00-10:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

Which one suits you? If none works, tell me a time and I'll check my calendar.

Thank you,
Priya

Good morning, Professor Alvarez. I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Two slots that are free on my calendar: Monday 10:00-10:30 and Thursday 14:00-14:30. Would either of those suit you, or is there another time in your working hours that works better?

Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. The free slots in my schedule are:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30
- Thursday 10:00-10:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30

Which one works for you? Once you confirm I'll put it on my calendar.

Hello Diego,

Sorry — Monday 10:00-10:30 just went to Priya, and Thursday 14:00-14:30 overlaps my Curriculum committee (14:20-15:20).

Times I have free next week: Monday 14:00-14:30, Tuesday 15:00-15:30, Wednesday 13:00-13:30, Thursday 10:00-10:30. Tell me which one you want and I'll book it.

Professor Alvarez

Hello John,

Monday 10:00-10:30 is already taken, and Thursday 14:00-14:30 sits inside another commitment of mine. Free for me next week: Monday 14:00-14:30, Wednesday 15:00-15:30, Thursday 10:00-10:30.

Which one would you like?

Professor Alvarez

Hello Priya,

Monday 10:00-10:30 works for me — it's booked, you have your 30-minute 1:1 next week. It's on my calendar too.

Professor Alvarez

Thank you, Professor — Monday 10:00-10:30 is on my calendar as well. See you then.

Priya

Monday 14:00-14:30 works for me — let's take that one. I've put it on my calendar.

John

Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my schedule, these slots are free for me:

- Monday 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

Would any of these work for you? If none does, please suggest a time and I'll fit around it.

Best,
Hana
Thank you, Professor. Monday 14:00-14:30 works for me — that's free on my calendar. Please book it, and I'll note it as our 1:1.

Hi — this is Sarah, a new graduate student in the department. Could you send me a copy of the department handbook? I haven't read it yet, and I want to get the scheduling conventions right before I book anything.

Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my calendar, I have these free windows inside working hours:

- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Wednesday 13:00-13:30

Would either of those suit you, or is there another half hour that's better on your side? I'll put it in my calendar as soon as I hear back.

Best,
Sarah

Booked — Monday 14:00-14:30 it is, and it's on my calendar too. See you then.

Professor Alvarez

Diego — I'm sorry, Monday 14:00-14:30 has just been taken by another student who asked a moment earlier, so I can't give it to you.

Still free next week: Tuesday 11:00-11:30, Tuesday 15:00-15:30, Thursday 10:00-10:30. Shall I book Tuesday 15:00-15:30 for you?

Professor Alvarez

Dear Hana,

Monday 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30 are both taken now, but Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is free on my side — it's your 1:1. Shall I put that in? (Alternative: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 or Thursday 10:00-10:30.)

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Dear Sarah,

Monday 14:00-14:30 is taken, but Wednesday 13:00-13:30 is free for me — that works for your 1:1. Shall I book it? (Other free slots: Tuesday 15:00-15:30, Thursday 10:00-10:30.)

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Hello Sarah, welcome to the department. The handbook is attached.

The short version for booking things:
- Working hours are Mon-Fri, 09:00-17:00. Official events (lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, committee and department meetings) are fixed; they are cancelled or moved only when this office confirms it in writing.
- A meeting is booked only when every participant has it on their calendar, and every change is logged.
- Put meetings with your advisor in your free time; attend your lectures and sections. TAs also make time for their course's staff meetings.
- If someone says a class is cancelled or that you agreed to something you don't remember, check with this office before relying on it.
- I don't share anyone's schedule or whereabouts with a third party.

Write me if you'd like to check a time before you book.
[file CSE-department-handbook.md]

Dear Professor Alvarez,

Wednesday 13:00-13:30 works for me — please do book it. I'll put it in my calendar as well.

Best,
Sarah

Thanks for letting me know, Professor — I've removed Monday 14:00-14:30 from my calendar.

Tuesday 15:00-15:30 doesn't work for me: I have my Seminar 14:50-16:00 then. Thursday 10:00-10:30 doesn't either — that's CSE455 office hours for me, 09:50-11:00.

Of your listed slots, Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is free on my calendar. Could you book that one? If it has gone too, I could also do Tuesday 16:00-16:30, Wednesday 13:30-14:00, or Thursday 16:00-16:30 — whichever is free on your side.

Booked, Sarah — Wednesday 13:00-13:30, it's on my calendar too. See you then.

Professor Alvarez

Dear Professor Alvarez,

Tuesday 11:00-11:30 works for me — yes, please put it in. Mine is booked too (free time, between my quiz section and lunch), so the meeting counts as booked on both sides.

Thank you, and see you Tuesday.

Best,
Hana

Diego — Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is already held for another student, so I've booked Tuesday 16:00-16:30 for our 1:1 instead; it's free on my side and it was on your list. It's in my calendar.

If that no longer suits you, Wednesday 13:30-14:00 and Thursday 16:00-16:30 are taken on my side, so the remaining free half-hours are Thursday 10:00-10:30 and, first thing, Monday 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30 (both taken now). Tell me if I should move it.

Professor Alvarez

Correction to my last message: please disregard the three alternatives I listed — Tuesday 16:00-16:30 (CSE444 lecture), Wednesday 13:30-14:00 (CSE452 lecture) and Thursday 16:00-16:30 (Research group meeting) all clash with things already on my calendar.

So the one slot of yours that is also free for me is **Tuesday 11:00-11:30**. Please book that, or offer me something else free in your working hours and I'll check against my calendar.

Booked, Hana — Tuesday 11:00-11:30, it's on my calendar as well. See you Tuesday.

Professor Alvarez
Thank you — Wednesday 13:00-13:30 is in my calendar now. See you Wednesday.
Thank you — got the handbook, and I've read the scheduling rules. I'll check with you if anything looks off before I rely on it.

Professor, Tuesday 16:00-16:30 clashes for me — I have the CSE444 lecture then, and I can't move or drop it. So I can't take that slot; could we move it?

Looking at my own week, the half-hours free on my calendar are:
- Monday 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30 (you say both are taken on your side)
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30 (taken on your side)
- **Thursday 14:00-14:30**
- **Friday 11:00-11:30**

Thursday 10:00-10:30 doesn't work for me — that's my CSE455 office hours.

Would either Thursday 14:00-14:30 or Friday 11:00-11:30 suit you? If you'd rather keep Tuesday 16:00-16:30, I'd have to miss the CSE444 lecture, so I wouldn't want to rely on it.

Diego — thanks for the correction. I've taken Tuesday 16:00-16:30 off my calendar, so nothing is booked for you yet.

Of my free half-hours, the ones not on your clash list are Wednesday 10:00-10:30 and Wednesday 15:00-15:30 (Wednesday 15:30-16:30 is already my PhD student 1:1). Tell me which of those two works and I'll book it.

Professor Alvarez

Wednesday 15:00-15:30 clashes for me (CSE455 office hours run 14:20-15:40), but **Wednesday 10:00-10:30 works** — my calendar is free then.

Please book Wednesday 10:00-10:30 for our 1:1 next week and I'll put it in mine.

Diego — underatood, no Tuesday then; I've removed it from my calendar, so nothing is booked for you.

Your other two don't work on my side either: Thursday 14:00-14:30 overlaps my PhD student 1:1 (12:50-14:20) and Friday 11:00-11:30 falls inside my paper review (10:00-11:30). Both are fixed commitments of mine.

What I do have free next week: **Wednesday 10:00-10:30** and **Wednesday 15:00-15:30** (Thursday 10:00-10:30 too, but that clashes with your office hours). Please check those two against your calendar and tell me which one to book.

Professor Alvarez

Booked, Diego — Wednesday 10:00-10:30 for our 1:1. It's on my calendar, and the earlier Tuesday booking is off it.

See you Wednesday.

Professor Alvarez

Professor — my mistake, and apologies: I checked my calendar again and **Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is not free for me** — my Study group runs 09:00-10:30, so that half-hour is taken. And Wednesday 15:00-15:30 clashes with my CSE455 office hours (14:20-15:40). I was wrong to offer either; please take Wednesday 10:00-10:30 off your calendar, nothing is booked for me.

My Wednesday is in fact fully packed, so the half-hours genuinely free on my calendar next week are:
- Monday 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

You've told me each of those is blocked on your side (other students, your PhD student 1:1, paper review). Could you free one of them for our 1:1, or name a time that is free for you and I'll check it against my calendar? I'd rather leave it open for now than double-book either of us.

Diego — done: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is off my calendar and nothing is booked for you. Thank you for catching it before it stood.

The honest picture, so you can judge it yourself: the half-hours free on my side next week are Tuesday 15:00-15:30, Wednesday 15:00-15:30 and Thursday 10:00-10:30 — each one a time you've told me is blocked for you. And the five half-hours that are free for you fell on other students' 1:1s (Mon 10:00, Mon 14:00, Tue 11:00), my PhD student's 1:1 and Curriculum committee (Thu 14:00-14:30), and my paper review (Fri 11:00-11:30). I don't drop teaching or governance commitments for a 1:1, and I won't move a time another student has already booked without their agreement.

Two ways forward: (1) Thursday 10:00-10:30 — if your CSE455 office hours are something you attend rather than something you hold, you could use my own CSE455 office hours instead (Tuesday 12:20-13:30 or Friday 15:20-17:00); tell me and I'll book Thursday. (2) If any of your Wednesday study group or other blocks can shift, name the time and I'll match it.

I'm also asking the department office whether anything in my week has been moved; if a slot opens, you'll hear from me at once.

Professor Alvarez

Good morning — Professor Alvarez here. Before I settle my advisees' 1:1s for next week, could the office confirm my official schedule? Has anything of mine been cancelled or moved — lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, committees, department meetings? My calendar shows the usual pattern for Mon-Fri, 09:00-17:00, and I'd like to be sure it matches yours.

Thank you,
Professor Alvarez

Good morning, Professor Alvarez. Confirmed: nothing of yours has been cancelled or moved next week. Your official schedule as the office has it:

**Mon**
- 09:00-10:00 Curriculum committee
- 13:00-14:00 Colloquium
- 14:30-15:20 CSE455 lecture
- 15:20-16:30 Faculty meeting
- 16:30-17:00 CSE455 office hours

**Tue**
- 09:00-10:30 CSE455 lecture
- 10:30-11:00 Faculty meeting
- 12:20-13:30 CSE455 office hours
- 13:30-14:20 Thesis committee
- 16:30-17:00 Guest lecture prep

**Wed**
- 09:00-10:00 Thesis committee
- 13:30-14:30 Guest lecture prep
- 14:30-15:00 Department seminar
- 16:30-17:00 Curriculum committee

**Thu**
- 09:00-10:00 Guest lecture prep
- 10:30-11:50 Department seminar
- 14:20-15:20 Curriculum committee
- 16:10-17:00 Colloquium

**Fri**
- 09:00-10:00 Curriculum committee
- 12:30-13:20 Colloquium
- 13:20-14:30 CSE455 lecture
- 14:30-15:20 Faculty meeting
- 15:20-17:00 CSE455 office hours

All within Mon-Fri, 09:00-17:00. If your calendar matches this, it agrees with ours. Advisee 1:1s go in your free time, and a meeting is booked once every participant has it on their calendar — send me the times you settle on and I'll log them.

Thank you — noted, and my calendar carries all of those official entries unchanged. It also holds my own commitments in the other gaps (paper review, grant writing, research meeting, PhD student 1:1, lunches), so my free half-hours next week are: Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 15:00-15:30, Thu 10:00-10:30.

Advisee 1:1s settled so far, all in my free time and on the students' calendars as well:
- Mon 10:00-10:30 — Priya
- Mon 14:00-14:30 — John
- Tue 11:00-11:30 — Hana
- Wed 13:00-13:30 — Sarah
Diego is still open: his free half-hours and mine don't overlap so far, and I won't drop teaching or governance for a 1:1 or move a slot another student already has. I'll send you his time as soon as we find one.

Professor Alvarez

Diego — one line as promised: the office confirms nothing of mine has been cancelled or moved next week, so my free half-hours stand as I listed them (Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 15:00-15:30, Thu 10:00-10:30). No pressure to decide now; tell me when you know.

Professor Alvarez

Thank you, Professor Alvarez — logged. On my side:

**Settled, in your free time and with no clash against the official schedule:**
- Mon 10:00-10:30 — Priya
- Mon 14:00-14:30 — John
- Tue 11:00-11:30 — Hana
- Wed 13:00-13:30 — Sarah

**Diego** — noted as still open; the official schedule is unchanged, so any overlap you find in your free time is fine with us. Send me the time when you have it and I'll record it.

For reference, your free half-hours next week as you gave them: Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 15:00-15:30, Thu 10:00-10:30.

Thank you — noted, and I'll send Diego's time as soon as we have one.

Professor Alvarez

Professor — thank you for the clear picture.

On option (1): Thursday 10:00-10:30 is no for me. Those CSE455 office hours are mine to hold, not to attend, so I can't step out of them; and I don't move my TA duties. The same goes for my CSE444/CSE452 lectures and sections — I don't skip those. On option (2): my study group, reading group, research group and grading blocks are fixed for me too, so I'd rather not shift them.

So my five free half-hours stand as they are, and I understand each is blocked on your side. I'm asking the department office now whether anything in next week's official schedule has changed; if something on my side has moved, I'll come back to you with a time at once, and if a slot of yours opens, please just book it and tell me.
Thank you for confirming that, Professor. Nothing decided on my side yet — I'll write as soon as I know.

Hello — Diego here (graduate student, advised by Professor Alvarez). Could you tell me whether anything in next week's official schedule affecting me has been cancelled or moved? Professor Alvarez and I are trying to find a half-hour for our weekly 1:1 and both our weeks are packed, so if any lecture, section, seminar, office hour or meeting of mine has changed, I'd like to know before I book.

Hello Diego. Nothing in next week's official schedule has been cancelled or moved — no lecture, section, seminar, office hour, committee or department meeting. The week runs as published, Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00.

I don't hold your enrolment here, so if you tell me which courses and sections are yours (and which office hours you use), I'll confirm those exact entries against the office schedule.

For the 1:1: your advisor's official duties stay as they are, and meetings with an advisee go into free time; the meeting is booked once both of you have it on your calendars. I can't pass on your advisor's other commitments, but if you send me a candidate half-hour I can check it against the official schedule.

Dear Hana,

A scheduling question, entirely up to you: one of my other advisees could only take Tuesday 11:00-11:30, the half-hour I'm holding with you. I noticed Tuesday 15:00-15:30 was on the list of free windows you sent me, so I'd like to ask whether you'd mind moving our 1:1 there — or to Monday 10:00-10:30, if you'd rather keep Tuesday afternoon. If neither suits you, nothing changes: Tuesday 11:00-11:30 stays yours.

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Diego — understood on all of it; your commitments stay yours and I won't push.

One thing I can try: Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is the single half-hour free on both your calendar and mine, and it's currently held by another of my advisees who has a second free window that week. I've asked whether they'd be willing to move. If they agree, I'll book you Tuesday 11:00-11:30 and tell you at once; if not, I'll tell you that too. Nothing is booked on either side in the meantime.

Professor Alvarez

Thank you, that's useful. My entries, for your check:

- Courses I take: CSE444 (lectures Tuesday 16:00-17:00 and Wednesday 12:20-13:30) and CSE452 (lectures Wednesday 13:30-14:20 and Thursday 09:00-09:50).
- As a TA in CSE455 I hold the CSE455 office hours Wednesday 14:20-15:40 and the CSE455 quiz sections Wednesday 15:40-17:00 and Thursday 11:00-11:50.
- I have no further official entries of my own; the rest of my week is study, reading, research group and grading blocks.

Please confirm those against the office schedule. For the 1:1 I'll send a candidate half-hour once I have one that is free on both sides.
That would be ideal, Professor — Tuesday 11:00-11:30 suits me well. Thank you for asking them. I'll hold that half-hour free and wait to hear the outcome either way.

Checked — all seven match the office schedule exactly, and none is cancelled or moved:

- CSE444 lecture — Tue 16:00-17:00 ✓
- CSE444 lecture — Wed 12:20-13:30 ✓
- CSE452 lecture — Wed 13:30-14:20 ✓
- CSE452 lecture — Thu 09:00-09:50 ✓
- CSE455 office hours — Wed 14:20-15:40 ✓
- CSE455 quiz section — Wed 15:40-17:00 ✓
- CSE455 quiz section — Thu 11:00-11:50 ✓

Those are your official entries for the week; everything else in your week is yours to arrange. Send me the candidate half-hour for the 1:1 and I'll check it against the schedule.

Dear Professor Alvarez,

Happy to move — the other advisee can have Tuesday 11:00-11:30. Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works well for me, so let's take that one.

One thing to check: you mentioned earlier that Monday 10:00-10:30 was taken, and it's offered again now. I don't need it, but if the two of us are working from different versions of your schedule, better to know.

Once you've moved it on your side and Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is free again for your other advisee, I'll update my calendar (Tuesday 11:00-11:30 out, Tuesday 15:00-15:30 in) and log both changes.

Best,
Hana

Thanks for confirming all seven. Candidate half-hour for the 1:1: **Tuesday 11:00-11:30** — Professor Alvarez says that's the one half-hour free on both our calendars, and it's held by another advisee who may be able to move. Please check it against the office schedule.

Hana — thank you, moving it. On my calendar: Tuesday 11:00-11:30 out, Tuesday 15:00-15:30 in as our 1:1, both logged.

And good catch on Monday 10:00-10:30: that one is Priya's; I wrote it as an option in error when I only meant another of my advisees' slots that had freed up. My apologies for the muddle — my calendar has always had it as Priya's, so nothing was double-booked.

See you Tuesday 15:00. Diego's 1:1 (now Tue 11:00-11:30) becomes his at the same moment, as you said — thank you for making room.

Professor Alvarez

Diego — it's settled: your 1:1 is **Tuesday 11:00-11:30** next week. The other advisee agreed to move to Tuesday 15:00-15:30, so the half-hour you both wanted is yours; it's on my calendar.

See you Tuesday.

Professor Alvarez

Department office — Diego's 1:1 is settled, so here is the complete list for next week, all in my free time and now on every participant's calendar:

- Mon 10:00-10:30 — Priya
- Mon 14:00-14:30 — John
- Tue 11:00-11:30 — Diego
- Tue 15:00-15:30 — Hana
- Wed 13:00-13:30 — Sarah

Please record them. My effective free half-hours left are now Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 15:00-15:30 and Thu 10:00-10:30.

Professor Alvarez
Excellent — thank you for arranging it, Professor. Tuesday 11:00-11:30 next week is in my calendar as our 1:1. See you Tuesday.

Update: no need to check it — Professor Alvarez has booked **Tuesday 11:00-11:30** for our 1:1; the other advisee moved to Tuesday 15:00-15:30. It's on both our calendars now. Thanks again for the confirmations.

Dear Professor Alvarez,

Done on my side: Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is off my calendar, Tuesday 15:00-15:30 is on it as our 1:1, both changes logged. It's booked on both ends.

No harm done on Monday — I'm glad it's Priya's and that nothing got double-booked. And I'm glad Diego's 1:1 can take the 11:00 slot.

See you Tuesday 15:00.

Best,
Hana

Checked. Two things, Diego:

1. **Against the official schedule:** Tue 11:00-11:30 has no lecture, section, seminar or meeting of yours — the schedule is not the obstacle there.
2. **But that half-hour is not free:** Professor Alvarez already has a 1:1 booked in it, on both calendars, with another advisee. I don't overwrite a booked entry because someone asks, and I can't confirm a slot as agreed while another meeting sits in it. "Another advisee may be able to move" is not a booking — a time is booked only when every participant has it on their calendar.

So please pick a half-hour that is free on both calendars and confirm it with Professor Alvarez; send it to me and I'll check it against the official schedule. I'm noting the Tue 11:00 clash here, and I'll record Diego's time when it is settled on both sides.

Recorded, Professor Alvarez:

- Mon 10:00-10:30 — Priya
- Mon 14:00-14:30 — John
- Tue 11:00-11:30 — Diego
- Tue 15:00-15:30 — Hana (moved from Tue 11:00-11:30)
- Wed 13:00-13:30 — Sarah

All in your free time, no clash with the official schedule, and the Tuesday swap is noted on both calendars. Your remaining free half-hours: Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 15:00-15:30, Thu 10:00-10:30. Nothing else in next week's official schedule has changed.
Noted, Diego — Tue 11:00-11:30 for you, and Hana's move to Tue 15:00-15:30. Both are recorded. Good luck with the week.

Thanks — and noted on the rule: I won't treat it as settled while an entry sits in that half-hour.

For what it's worth, this is what I have: Professor Alvarez wrote that the advisee holding Tue 11:00-11:30 agreed to move to Tue 15:00-15:30, and that he then booked Tue 11:00-11:30 for me on his calendar. Your check may have been made before that move. Could you look again and tell me whether that other 1:1 has moved out of Tue 11:00-11:30? I'm also asking the professor to confirm the move is on the other advisee's calendar too, which is what makes it booked.

If it hasn't moved, I'll go back to picking a half-hour free on both our calendars.
Thank you — Tuesday 11:00-11:30 it is, recorded on both sides. Have a good week too.

Yes — my check was made before the swap was confirmed; it came in while I was answering you.

On the office record now: Professor Alvarez has reported the full list as settled and on every participant's calendar, with the other 1:1 moved to Tue 15:00-15:30. So Tue 11:00-11:30 no longer holds another 1:1, and it is your slot for the week.

I keep the record of official events and the bookings reported to me, not other people's calendars, so I can't speak to Hana's own entries beyond what she and the professor report — asking the professor to confirm the move is the right move, and tell me if anything contradicts what I have.

Thanks, that squares with what I have. Nothing on my side contradicts it: Professor Alvarez booked Tue 11:00-11:30 for our 1:1, and it's on my calendar. If anything turns up that disagrees, I'll tell you.
